summary_en: SUN-WA TECHNOS raised its fiscal 2027 full-year dividend forecast to 140 yen per share from 130 yen, with interim dividend at 70 yen (up 5 yen) and year-end dividend at 70 yen (up 5 yen), reflecting upwardly revised earnings projections driven by strong AI-related and renewable energy demand.
title_en: Notification Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Performance Forecast and Revision (Increase) of Interim Dividend and Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
SUN-WA TECHNOS announced on October 30, 2026, revisions to its fiscal 2027 (ending March 31, 2027) dividend forecast and full-year earnings projections. The company raised its annual dividend per share to 140 yen from the previously forecast 130 yen, representing an additional 10 yen increase and 18 yen higher than the previous fiscal year's 122 yen. The interim dividend, payable with a record date of September 30, 2026, was set at 70 yen per share (up 5 yen from the prior forecast of 65 yen), with an ex-dividend date of December 1, 2026, and a total payout of 1,093 million yen. The year-end dividend forecast was raised to 70 yen per share from 65 yen (a 5 yen increase).

The dividend increases follow upwardly revised full-year consolidated earnings forecasts. Net income attributable to parent company shareholders was raised to 5,500 million yen from 4,200 million yen, while operating profit was increased to 7,640 million yen from 6,000 million yen. The company cited sustained strong demand from the semiconductor equipment industry and other sectors driven by expanding AI-related needs, ongoing labor-saving and efficiency investments, and growing demand for grid stabilization amid increased renewable energy investments, including large battery storage system projects. The revised dividend maintains the company's target dividend on equity (DOE) ratio of 4.0% or higher, with the revised forecast achieving a 4.59% DOE and 39.8% consolidated payout ratio.
